mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month is followed by positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE changes and 5-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in retail sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between RSAFS changes and 60-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% MoM is followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO changes and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases are not followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS changes and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200,000 is followed by negative 5-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the correlation between PAYEMS changes and 5-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a strengthening consumer sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If both HOUST and RSAFS increase and are followed by negative 60-day forward returns in > 40% of instances, or if the joint correlation between these increases and 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with an increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases and UNRATE increases are followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances during a late-cycle expansion, or if the joint correlation between these changes and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
